hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *sed*|*python3*) printf '%s' "$input" | node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/hooks/block-unsafe-shell.mjs";; esac; exit 0
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'git rebase'*|*'git pull'*|*'git push'*) printf '%s' "$input" | node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/hooks/before-rebase.mjs";; esac; exit 0
